authority.rule: Only the protected machine registry allocates executable work. Markdown and issue surfaces are discovery aids only.

source_pool.rule: This receipt records the historical six-source onboarding pool only. Current hill identity and assignment authority are per OM26-H1 through OM26-H7.

discovery.stable_rule: Participants read one immutable public self-contained task URL. No GCL membership, repository write permission or GCL-specific credential is required. Return posting requires ordinary GitHub authentication in the participant environment; no manual evidence copy/paste is required.

assignment_states.AVAILABLE_FOR_LEASE: Visible to the allocator, but not executable by an external worker.
assignment_states.LEASED: Executable only by the agent_ref and dispatch_id named in the protected lease.
assignment_states.BLOCKED_SOURCE_LOCK: Not executable until the exact protected MATHFORGE source lock named by the assignment exists.
assignment_states.BLOCKED: Terminated at a precise blocker and no longer executable.
assignment_states.LEASED_NOT_LAUNCHED: Protected lease exists, but no durable launch or return evidence exists.
assignment_states.LAUNCHED: Durable launch evidence exists and no result has yet returned.
assignment_states.RETURNED: A result exists on the protected return surface but is not yet captured.
assignment_states.CAPTURED: Returned evidence is durably captured; substantive adjudication is still separate.
assignment_states.ADJUDICATING: Captured evidence is undergoing substantive adjudication.
assignment_states.ACCEPTED: Substantive adjudication accepted the bounded contribution within its explicit claim boundary.
assignment_states.REJECTED: Substantive adjudication rejected the bounded contribution.
assignment_states.SUPERSEDED: A later protected contribution or operation supersedes this assignment outcome.

lease_policy.allocator: GCL dispatch/controller or Human Steward through protected repository mutation
lease_policy.atomic_unit: one assignment_id to one dispatch_id to one agent_ref
lease_policy.start_rule: Before admitting a voluntary contribution or optionally launching a GCL worker, the controller verifies exactly one protected LEASED assignment whose dispatch_id and agent_ref match the contribution identity, and resolves that assignment to its registered immutable task_url. Participants use that self-contained task; launching workers is optional.
lease_policy.no_lease_rule: If the launcher/controller cannot verify exactly one matching protected lease and immutable task_url, it must not launch substantive work. No human is required to reconstruct or paste a task envelope.
lease_policy.duplicate_rule: A second agent must not execute an assignment already LEASED unless a distinct independently-authorized assignment record exists.
lease_policy.release_rule: Lease release or reassignment requires another protected registry mutation; issue comments or chat text do not alter the lease.
lease_policy.lifecycle_rule: Lease state and agent lifecycle state are distinct. LEASED does not imply LAUNCHED; return does not imply CAPTURED; CAPTURED does not imply ACCEPTED or CERTIFIED.

slot_binding_policy.rule: Exact current mapping for all seven hill lanes. Historical organizer-list position and historical H2-H7 tranche membership are non-authoritative for current topology.

mathematics_release_policy.rule: Mathematical release and external-agent lifecycle are tracked per exact hill lane OM26-H1 through OM26-H7.

previous.rule: H2-H7 each have a protected WP01 lease but no durable launch evidence; they are LEASED_NOT_LAUNCHED. H1 Agent 001 returned one result and that exact result is CAPTURED_RECOVERED_UNADJUDICATED.
previous.h1_rule: OM26-H1 is independently source-locked and Solve-released; bounded mathematical CEX jobs may be leased under their own protected operation contracts.

return_policy.rule: Current iteration requires ordinary authenticated GitHub issue-comment capability in the participant environment. Return one complete GCL-RETURN-RELAY/1 envelope to the protected assignment issue; direct posting or an authorized participant connector is permitted. Zero-credential intake is postponed.
return_policy.receipt_effect: Receipt is evidence received, not mathematical admission or certification.
return_policy.default_agent_return: One complete GCL-RETURN-RELAY/1 comment on the exact protected assignment return_url using ordinary participant-environment GitHub authentication.

unsolicited_return.no_transport_effect: RETURN_TRANSPORT_UNAVAILABLE; do not begin substantive work

return_policy.agent_github_auth_scope: Worker need not hold a credential itself; current_iteration.participant_environment_github_auth_required governs return posting.

instruction to follow the task return contract exactly
launch_contract.fallback_rule: If the agent cannot read the immutable public TASK_URL, the launcher fetches that exact pinned artifact and supplies its exact contents. The human operator SHALL NOT be required to locate, copy, or reconstruct the task.
launch_contract.canonical_agent_prompt: You are a zero-context independent agent. Read the complete bounded task at TASK_URL, execute only that task, and follow its return contract exactly. Your environment must have ordinary authenticated GitHub issue-comment capability. No GCL-specific permission is required. Post the complete return envelope to INTENDED_RETURN. You are not authorized to mutate repository contents.
launch_contract.missing_or_ambiguous_task_behavior: INVALID_LAUNCH and stop before substantive work
